questions.question:
Which of the following claims is supported by the evidence below?
Evidence: "Over 70% of middle school students reported feeling more focused after participating in daily physical activity."

options.text: "Students should study longer hours to improve focus."
"Focus has no connection to physical activity."

Which claim does this support?

Evidence: "Museum visitors score higher on history tests."
Which claim does this support?

Claim: "Drinking water is essential for good health."
Supporting Statement: "I feel more energetic after drinking water during the day."

Claim: "Physical activity reduces stress."
Supporting Statement: "The Mayo Clinic reports that regular exercise increases endorphins and reduces stress hormones."

questions.question:
Claim: Fast food is unhealthy and should be avoided.
Which is a counterclaim?

options.text: Fast food often contains too much fat and sugar.
Eating fast food regularly can lead to health problems.
Some fast-food restaurants now offer healthier options like salads.

questions.question:
Claim: Sports take up too much study time for students.
Which is the correct counterclaim?

options.text: Sports keep students physically healthy and teach teamwork.
Many students skip homework to play sports.

questions.question:
Claim: Books are better than e-books.
Which is a counterclaim?

options.text: E-books are easier to carry and store than printed books.
Printed books have a nice smell and feel.
Many people prefer to read books in libraries.

questions.question:
Counterclaim: "Mobile phones distract students from learning."
What is the claim?

options.text: Mobile phones help students learn better.
Mobile phones should never be used anywhere.

questions.question:
Counterclaim: "School uniforms stop students from showing their individuality."
What is the claim?

options.text: School uniforms create equality among students.
